followUp.title: Wire up Go recording binary and systemd services
followUp.description:
Stories 9 and 10 created internal/recording/ with excellent Go implementations of birdnet_recording.sh and custom_recording.sh — but the code is never called. This story completes the migration by creating an entry point binary, systemd service files, a Makefile target, and documentation.

## What to create

### 1. cmd/birdnet-recording/main.go
A standalone binary that:
- Accepts a --mode flag: 'standard' (default) or 'custom' to select recording.Run() vs recording.RunCustom()
- Reads config path from BIRDNET_CONFIG env var (default: /etc/birdnet/birdnet.conf), loads it via config.NewManager() then config.Load()
- Converts config to recording.RecordingConfig via recording.ConfigFromManager(cfg.Config), then to recording.CustomRecordingConfig via recording.CustomConfigFromManager() if custom mode
- Sets up signal handling: listens for SIGTERM and SIGINT, cancels the context for graceful shutdown
- Logs startup info (mode, key config values like RTSP_STREAM or REC_CARD)
- Calls recording.Run(ctx, cfg) or recording.RunCustom(ctx, customCfg) and exits with appropriate code
- Follow the pattern of cmd/server/main.go for env var handling (getEnv helper, expandHome, etc.)

### 2. deployment/birdnet-recording.service
Systemd unit file for standard recording. Model after deployment/birdnet-api.service:
- ExecStart=/home/birdnet/BirdNET-Pi/bin/birdnet-recording --mode standard
- Environment=BIRDNET_CONFIG=/etc/birdnet/birdnet.conf
- User=birdnet, Restart=always, RestartSec=3
- After=network.target pulseaudio.service
- Resource limits similar to birdnet-api.service

### 3. deployment/birdnet-custom-recording.service
Same as above but with --mode custom. Should be disabled by default (matching the original custom_recording.sh behavior which was opt-in).

### 4. Makefile targets
Add to existing Makefile:
- build-recording: builds cmd/birdnet-recording to bin/birdnet-recording
- build-recording-arm64: cross-compile for Pi
- Update 'build-all-platforms' to include the recording binary
- Update 'install' target to also build the recording binary

### 5. Documentation
- Add a 'Recording Service' section to CLAUDE.md documenting cmd/birdnet-recording, its flags, and the systemd services
- Update README.md services table to note the Go recording binary replaces the shell scripts
- Fix docs/ml-service.md: change the Go import path example from 'github.com/your-org/birdnet-pi' to 'github.com/birdnet-pi/birdnet' (the actual module path from go.mod)

### 6. Delete deprecated shell scripts
Now that the Go binary exists and is wired up:
- Delete scripts/runtime/birdnet_recording.sh
- Delete scripts/runtime/custom_recording.sh
- Delete scripts/tools/read_chunks.sh (zero references, already deprecated)
- Keep scripts/lib/config.sh for now (still used by install scripts)
